name: Floodman Operations Full ERP Login Runtime
description: Cumulative Floodman server release with one main ERP login for the ERP, Office, and integrated RoomFlow workspaces, plus the authentication-aware launcher and browser boot guard.
features: server-only v4.6.8 test identity so Pterodactyl can distinguish this cumulative build from the prior v4.6.7 package
main Floodman ERP login establishes the authenticated Office and RoomFlow session without storing ERP credentials or tokens
RoomFlow login returns users to their requested estimator workspace after successful ERP authentication
existing same-origin ERP browser sessions can be connected to Office and RoomFlow through verified token exchange
authentication-aware /full-erp launcher opens ERP login for unsigned-in browsers and dashboard for authenticated browsers
ERP boot guard is served and injected into the genuine browser bundle
HTTP 200 with JSON false from /api/auth/authenticated is treated as login-required rather than server failure
full ERP status page separates browser-bundle readiness from ERP API readiness
Tailscale HTTPS ports remain HTTPS even when an upstream proxy omits X-Forwarded-Proto
same-origin Floodman Office health probe replaces unreliable navigator.onLine status
desktop dashboard provider snapshot is bounded so optional upstream services cannot block navigation
service worker distinguishes a starting Office service from a truly unreachable Floodman hub
dynamic Office navigation receives a longer recovery window before fallback
private Tailscale-only desktop sessions remain online when Floodman itself responds
dedicated /office/desktop desktop operations workspace
dedicated /office/mobile phone and tablet workspace
adaptive /workspace launcher used by the PWA
desktop touchscreens no longer misclassified as mobile devices
explicit desktop and mobile workspace preference controls
current v4.6.8 Hub and PWA assets served instead of stale v4.1.0 assets
PWA opens desktop on computers and mobile on phones or tablets
persistent RoomFlow workspace records recovered from prior v4.6.2 imports
imported Supabase organizations automatically selected after migration
encrypted Mobile API workspace list create and select actions
workspace-aware RoomFlow jobs customers properties estimates and catalog items
safe default Floodman workspace when no original organization has been imported
idempotent workspace repair without deleting or duplicating existing RoomFlow jobs
active runtime marker prevents stale v4.6.0 and v4.6.1 overlay confusion
zero Pillow/PIL imports in the Floodman Office runtime
dependency-safe Floodman Office startup without a hard Pillow/PIL requirement
direct embedding of native RoomFlow JPEG layout captures in estimate PDFs
graceful validation for unsupported image formats instead of an Office API crash
one-time authenticated import from the original RoomFlow Supabase account
idempotent migration of RoomFlow customers jobs snapshots catalog estimates and lines
RoomFlow bootstrap API with complete saved snapshots and customer/property/estimate relationships
server capability contract for matched Android releases
explicit layout-capture requirement for imported historical jobs
editable estimate and invoice headers on native mobile apps
full estimate lifecycle: view edit PDF send authorize accept deposit payment convert delete
full invoice lifecycle: create edit PDF send payment void delete
actual saved RoomFlow layout embedded in estimate PDF
category-driven recommended project plans
calendar for jobs inspections estimates follow-ups deliveries training and meetings
multiple employee assignment and lead employee selection
employee scheduling conflict detection and controlled override
tasks announcements notifications and calendar subscriptions
public encrypted Android Mobile API preserved
public customer signing and payments preserved
America/Detroit time zone
dark-mode preferences for native apps and PWA data model
searchable shared Floodman and RoomFlow catalog
custom catalog items persist to Floodman data
tokenized card payments plus cash check ACH and external payments
